ask.title: Get a message when your order is ready
ask.body: On iPhone, first add {{kitchen}} to your Home Screen. 4 quick taps, about a minute.
ask.skip: Not now, I'll check the order page

copyHint: After tapping: "Link copied. Now open Safari."

step1.title: Tap the ••• button
step1.body: It's at the bottom right of the screen.
step1.older: Older iPhone? Tap the Share button instead, then skip to step 3.

step2.title: Tap "Share"
step2.body: It's in the menu that just opened.
step2.bodyOther: It's in your browser's bar, a square with an arrow pointing up.

step3.title: Tap "Add to Home Screen"
step3.body: Don't see it? Tap "More" or scroll down.

step4.title: Tap "Add"
step4.body: Top right. Leave "Open as Web App" switched on.

open.title: Now open {{kitchen}} from your Home Screen
open.body: It opens straight to order {{code}}. Turn on notifications there.
open.bodyNoCode: It opens straight to your order. Turn on notifications there.
open.cantFindHelp: Look through your Home Screen pages, or swipe down on the Home Screen and type {{kitchen}}.
open.stay: Stay here and check the order page

iosInApp.title: First, open this page in Safari
iosInApp.body: You're inside {{app}}. Order updates only work from Safari on iPhone.
iosInApp.step3: Tap the address bar and Paste and Go

androidInApp.title: First, open this page in Chrome
androidInApp.body: You're inside {{app}}, which can't send order updates.

copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Press and hold the address bar to copy it.

android.allowBody: Tap Allow when your phone asks.

notify.offBody: Your phone will ask. Tap Allow and we'll tell you when order {{code}} is ready.
notify.offBodyNoCode: Your phone will ask. Tap Allow and we'll tell you when your order is ready.
notify.onBody: We'll tell you when your order is ready.
notify.blockedBody: Your phone is set to not show them. You can turn them back on in your iPhone's Settings:
notify.blockedBodyAndroid: Your phone or browser is set to not show them. You can allow them again.
notify.blockedBodyDesktop: This browser is set to not show them. You can allow them again.
notify.blockedAndroid: On Android: in Chrome tap ⋮, then Settings, Site settings, Notifications, and allow {{domain}}.
notify.blockedDesktop: Click the lock or settings icon next to the address, then allow Notifications for {{domain}}.
notify.stillBlocked: Still blocked. Check the setting, then tap again.
notify.notSetUpTitle: Notifications aren't set up on this server yet
notify.notSetUpBody: Nothing is wrong with your phone. Your order page always shows the latest.
notify.failedBody: Check your connection and try again. Your order page always shows the latest.
notify.unsupportedBody: Your order page always shows the latest. For messages, use Safari on iPhone (added to your Home Screen) or Chrome on Android.

card.title: Get a message when your order is ready
card.body: Takes a minute. Or skip it and check this order page.
card.onBody: We'll tell you when your order is ready.
card.blockedBody: Turn them back on in your phone's settings to get a message when it's ready.

settings.homeFallback: No Install button? Tap ⋮ in Chrome, then Add to home screen.
